notes.hook: 'Kitne ka hai ye?' '₹15,000.' '₹5,000.' 'Chhotu, pack kar.' in the first 4 seconds
notes.what_goes_wrong: Almost nothing; at 19 seconds the only risk is the 8-second gap with no line (4-12s).
notes.reusable_pattern: A 15-20 second shop-counter haggling skit with real prices said out loud; the punchline is the shopkeeper's reaction.
